documentation.content:
The dashboard **__SERVICE__** logged an error (a failed request or an internal error).

- Errors grouped: https://console.cloud.google.com/errors?project=__PROJECT__
- Logs: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="__SERVICE__" AND severity>=ERROR' --project __PROJECT__ --limit 20`

Each log entry links to its trace in Cloud Trace.
